concerns.text: Non-sequential identifier gaps: FR-005, FR-013, and FR-015 are missing; SC-003 and SC-005 are missing.
Incomplete cross-reference: SC-006 lists artifacts from both US-1 and US-2 but only cites '(See US-1)'.

Broken traceability: FR-006, FR-007, and FR-017 reference US-2 and US-1 respectively, but the corresponding User Stories do not contain the logic or requirements mentioned (e.g., associational framing, limitation documentation, or schema validation).
Terminology instability: The spec uses 'atomic size mismatch' while the Constitution uses 'atomic size difference' for the same descriptor.
